objections.claim_attacked: post_state/chosen_intervention: conclusion that the groute map is wrong and 'without macros this should be easily routable'
objections.objection: The record already contains independent non-macro causes — ~90%+ placement density from -density 0.95 and 62 DPL-0036 detailed-placement failures — so removing macros is not shown to imply easy routability and the counterfactual is asserted without a no-macro/low-density rerun.

objections.claim_attacked: hypothesis: RUDY-vs-GRT resource accounting mismatch is the central explanation
objections.objection: The same observation gives physical mechanisms that can explain the GRT map without any RUDY bug: RAM OBS blocks M1–M5 leaving only M6 over macros, metal1 usage is 1043.75%, and DPL pin-access failures are present, so the episode should not let a display-accounting mismatch swallow the pin/OBS/density causal chain.

objections.claim_attacked: observation numeric framing: metal1 usage 1043.75% with total 194.23% and overflow 180004 treated as evidence the heatmap is 'completely wrong'
objections.objection: A >1000% metal1 usage figure is internally consistent with severe M1 pin/OBS congestion and does not by itself prove the global-route map is globally wrong; the record gives no layer-by-layer available-versus-total capacity accounting to localize the error.
